declarations.docstring: An auxiliary property of an object in a category with zero morphisms.
For every object, there are displayed data yielding an epimorphism.
An object with this auxiliary property is projective.
An auxiliary property of an object in a category.
This property is equivalent to projectivity together with the displayed epimorphism condition on coproduct desc maps.
This auxiliary property makes the object a separator.
This auxiliary property makes the object projective.
